def get(self, key, default=None):
        p = self._path(key)
        if not os.path.exists(p):
            return default
        with open(p) as f:
            rec = json.load(f)
        age = self._now() - rec["t"]
        if age > self.ttl:
            os.remove(p)
            return default
        return rec["v"]
